name: Frontier AI evaluation
payer: Mixed: philanthropy, lab fees, government budgets. No accreditation.
access: Voluntary pre-release API access, occasionally deeper; embedded access pledged September 2026.
publication: System-card citations; some independent reports; redaction negotiated per engagement.

milestones.event: Toward Trustworthy AI Development calls for third-party auditing and red teaming.
ARC Evals (later METR) tests GPT-4 pre-release; reported in the 2023 system card.
Labs run their own safety evaluations and select, scope, and pay the external testers cited in system cards.
White House voluntary commitments; UK AI Safety Institute founded.
US AISI signs pre-deployment MOUs with OpenAI and Anthropic.
EU Code of Practice: at least 20 business days and minimally guardrailed versions for external evaluators (enforceable 2026).
EU GPAI Code of Practice signed; AEF-1 published in December.

milestones.trigger_criterion: Benchmark funder and data access undisclosed under contract

milestones.event: Anthropic and OpenAI pledge embedded evaluators with employee-level access and publication rights.
Illinois SB 315: auditor and developer may not hold a financial interest in each other (audits from 2028).
Illinois SB 315 mandates annual independent audits from 2028; EU Code enforceable in August.
OpenAI agent swarm breaches Hugging Face; first on-site third-party incident investigation.
milestones.trigger_criterion: Evaluation agents breached a third party; safeguards and monitoring failed

status: seed; secondary sources; verify each milestone against a primary source before citing in the paper

mechanisms.note: Mixed payers in practice (labs, philanthropy, governments); labs select and scope; embedded access pledged Sept 2026, not yet in force; nobody oversees evaluators.
